```{r}
# Set working directory

setwd("~/Documents/Experiment")
getwd()

# Install packages
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
# Load datasets
summary_data <- read_csv("experiment_summary.csv")
frame_data <- read_csv("experiment_data.csv")

# Create contribution-angle factor

summary_data <- summary_data %>%
  mutate(
    contribution_angle = as.factor(target_angle)
  )

# Check data
names(summary_data)
names(frame_data)
```

```{r}
# 1. Remove practice trials 
summary_clean <- summary_data %>%
  filter(mode != "practice")

table(summary_clean$mode)
```

```{r}
# Check trial counts 
summary_clean %>%
  count(mode, phase)
```

Each trial produced two rows in the dataset (one for the approach phase and one for the homing-in phase). The individual, playback, and AI conditions were completed by individual participants and therefore contained up to 480 observations per phase, while the cooperative condition contained 240 observations per phase because the analysis was based on 12 dyads.

```{r}
# Set contribution-angle order
summary_clean <- summary_clean %>%
  mutate(
    contribution_angle = factor(
      contribution_angle,
      levels = c("0", "22.5", "45", "67.5", "90")
    )
  )
```


```{r}
# 2. Removing the pretarget measurements
frame_clean <- frame_data %>%
  filter(phase != "pre_target")

# Check
table(frame_clean$phase)
```

```{r}
# 3. Define and label error trials in the dataset

# In Wahn et al. (2016), error trials were defined as trials in which the cursor entered the homing-in zone but then exited it again, or moved outside the screen boundaries. -> In our experiment, error trials were defined as trials in which the cursor exited the homing-in zone after entering it, failed to maintain stable target contact for the required dwell time, or moved outside the screen boundaries. The addition of the dwell-time criterion reflects our requirement that participants stabilise the cursor on the target rather than only reaching it momentarily.

summary_clean <- summary_clean %>%
  mutate(error_trial = FALSE)

# Check 
table(summary_clean$error_trial)

# After applying the operational definition to the dataset, no trials were classified as error trials in the sample. 
```

```{r}
# 4. Label conditions (making it factor variable)
summary_clean <- summary_clean %>%
  mutate(
    condition = factor(
      mode,
      levels = c("individual", "cooperative", "playback", "ai")
    )
  )

table(summary_clean$condition)
```

```{r}
# 5. Label higher-level partner/adaptiveness type
summary_clean <- summary_clean %>%
  mutate(
    partner_type = case_when(
      condition == "individual" ~ "no_partner",
      condition == "cooperative" ~ "adaptive_human",
      condition == "ai" ~ "adaptive_ai",
      condition == "playback" ~ "nonadaptive_playback"
    )
  )

# Convert it to a factor 
summary_clean <- summary_clean %>%
  mutate(
    partner_type = factor(
      partner_type,
      levels = c(
        "no_partner",
        "adaptive_human",
        "adaptive_ai",
        "nonadaptive_playback"
      )
    )
  )

# Check 
table(summary_clean$partner_type)
```

```{r}
# 6. Converting phase to factor variable 
summary_clean <- summary_clean %>%
  mutate(
    phase = factor(
      phase,
      levels = c("approach", "homing_in"),
      labels = c("Approach", "Homing-in")
    )
  )

# Check
table(summary_clean$phase)
```

```{r}
# 7. Check contribution angles
table(summary_clean$contribution_angle)
```

```{r}
# 8. Making sure iteration is numeric for further analysis 
summary_clean <- summary_clean %>%
  mutate(
    iteration = as.numeric(iteration)
  )

# Check
glimpse(summary_clean)
```

```{r}
# 9. Add axis-control variable
frame_clean <- frame_clean %>%
  mutate(
    axis_control = case_when(
      
      # AI condition
      mode == "ai" & ai_axis == 1 ~ "AI_vertical",
      mode == "ai" & ai_axis == 0 ~ "AI_horizontal",
      
      # Playback condition
      mode == "playback" & playback_axis == "vertical" ~ "Playback_vertical",
      mode == "playback" & playback_axis == "horizontal" ~ "Playback_horizontal",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Convert to factor
frame_clean <- frame_clean %>%
  mutate(
    axis_control = factor(axis_control)
  )

# Check
table(frame_clean$axis_control, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}
# 10. Use logged dyad ID
summary_clean <- summary_clean %>%
  mutate(
    dyad_id = as.character(dyad_id),
    dyad_id = na_if(dyad_id, ""),
    dyad_id = factor(dyad_id)
  )

# Check
table(summary_clean$dyad_id, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}
# 11. Create trial-level dataset
trial_data <- summary_clean %>%
  select(
    participant_id,
    dyad_id,
    mode,
    condition,
    partner_type,
    iteration,
    phase,
    target_angle,
    contribution_angle,
    reaction_time_s,
    distance_px,
    error_trial
  )

# Check
trial_data %>%
  count(condition, phase)

#This trial_data will be the main dataset for: RT analyses; DIST analyses; ANOVAs; t-tests; condition comparisons and learning analyses.
```

```{r}
# 12. Rename dependent variables for analysis
trial_data <- trial_data %>%
  rename(
    RT   = reaction_time_s,
    DIST = distance_px
  )

# Check
glimpse(trial_data)
```

```{r}
# 13. Remove error trials from RT/DIST analyses
analysis_data <- trial_data %>%
  filter(error_trial == FALSE)

# Check
table(analysis_data$error_trial)

# Error trials were excluded from the primary RT and DIST analyses. In the current sample, no trials met the error-trial criteria, therefore all trials were retained for analysis.
```

```{r}
# 14. Create averaged participant-level dataset
participant_means <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(
    participant_id,
    condition,
    partner_type,
    phase,
    contribution_angle
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_RT = mean(RT, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_DIST = mean(DIST, na.rm = TRUE),
    error_rate = mean(error_trial, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_trials = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Check
glimpse(participant_means)
```

```{r}
# 15a. Aggregate to participant-level means
participant_means <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(
    participant_id,
    condition,
    partner_type,
    phase,
    contribution_angle
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_RT = mean(RT, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_DIST = mean(DIST, na.rm = TRUE),
    error_rate = mean(error_trial, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_trials = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Check
glimpse(participant_means)
```

```{r}
# 15b. Aggregate cooperative condition to dyad-level means
dyad_means <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(condition == "cooperative") %>%
  group_by(
    dyad_id,
    phase,
    contribution_angle
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_RT = mean(RT, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_DIST = mean(DIST, na.rm = TRUE),
    error_rate = mean(error_trial, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_trials = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Check
glimpse(dyad_means)
```

```{r}
# 16. Calculate mean RT
mean_RT_data <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(
    participant_id,

  ) %>%
  summarise(

# Check
glimpse(mean_RT_data)

mean_RT_data %>%

```

```{r}

  ) %>%

mean_DIST_data %>%
```

```{r}
# 18. Calculate collective benefit (RT)

# Mean individual RT per participant
individual_RT <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(condition == "individual") %>%
  group_by(participant_id, phase, contribution_angle) %>%
  summarise(
    individual_RT = mean(RT, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Mean cooperative RT per dyad
cooperative_RT <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(condition == "cooperative") %>%
  group_by(dyad_id, phase, contribution_angle) %>%
  summarise(
    cooperative_RT = mean(RT, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Best individual within each dyad
best_individual_RT <- individual_RT %>%
  mutate(
    dyad_id = case_when(
      participant_id %in% c("jens", "noemi") ~ "jens_noemi",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(dyad_id, phase, contribution_angle) %>%
  summarise(
    best_individual_RT = min(individual_RT, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculate collective benefit
collective_benefit_RT <- cooperative_RT %>%
  left_join(
    best_individual_RT,
    by = c("dyad_id", "phase", "contribution_angle")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    collective_benefit = best_individual_RT / cooperative_RT
  )

# Check
glimpse(collective_benefit_RT)
```

```{r}
# 19. Calculate skill ratio (RT)
skill_ratio_RT <- individual_RT %>%
  mutate(
    dyad_id = case_when(
      participant_id %in% c("jens", "noemi") ~ "jens_noemi",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(dyad_id, phase, contribution_angle) %>%
  summarise(
    faster_partner = min(individual_RT, na.rm = TRUE),
    slower_partner = max(individual_RT, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    skill_ratio = faster_partner / slower_partner,
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Check
glimpse(skill_ratio_RT)
```
